main.description: Adopts an existing account as a community: this AppView takes custody of its credentials, creates the four community spaces on whichever PDS already hosts it, and seeds the same starter layout social.colibri.beta.community.create does. The account keeps its own DID, handle and PDS, and the caller becomes its owner. Use this instead of community.create to bring your own DID.

did.description: The account to adopt. The credentials must authenticate as this exact DID, which is what proves the caller controls it.

identifier.description: The identifier used to authenticate with the account's PDS, such as its handle or DID.

password.description: The account's password. An app password is not enough: minting a delegation token requires full access.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The arguments are inconsistent or malformed beyond schema validation.

errors.name: AlreadyExists
errors.description: This account is already a community on this AppView.

errors.name: CredentialsRejected
errors.description: The PDS refused the given identifier and password.

errors.name: IdentityMismatch
errors.description: The credentials authenticate a different account than the DID given.

errors.name: SpacesUnsupported
errors.description: The account's PDS does not implement com.atproto.simplespace, so it cannot host community spaces.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: A PDS or third-party call the AppView depends on failed.
